At Zaio, our primary goal is to equip you with the skills and knowledge
you need to excel in the field of programming. By the end of this
bootcamp, you can expect to:
Master Programming Fundamentals: Develop a solid foundation in
programming languages, algorithms, data structures, and problem-
solving techniques.
Build Real-World Agentic Projects: Gain hands-on experience by working
on projects that simulate real industry scenarios, allowing you to
showcase your abilities to potential employers.
Collaborate Effectively: Learn how to work efficiently in a team,
participate in collaborative coding environments, and communicate your
ideas effectively.
Receive Career Support: Benefit from resume building, interview
preparation, and job placement assistance to help you launch your career
in tech.

To effectively participate in a full-stack web development course, it's
essential to have a laptop that meets certain minimum hardware
requirements to ensure smooth operation of development tools and
environments. Here are the recommended specifications:
Operating System:
A current Windows-based laptop with PowerShell or a Mac with
Terminal. 
Processor:
A dual-core Intel i5, AMD 3000+ (CPU), or Apple M1 processor, or
greater in power. 
Memory (RAM):
At least 4 or 8 GB of RAM is required for efficient multitasking and
handling of development environments. 
Storage:
A solid-state drive (SSD) with at least 256 GB of storage is
recommended for faster data access and improved performance. 
Internet Connection:
For online classes, a high-speed internet connection is essential.
Recommended minimum speeds are 10 Mbps for download and 3
Mbps for upload.

As a distinguished participant in this program, your enrolment grants you
access to our advanced Learning Management System. 
This sophisticated platform has been curated to offer a comprehensive
suite of resources and interactive modules, strategically designed to
elevate your proficiency in full-stack AI engineering.
Each student will have access to a calendar that has daily tasks setup for
them. You will need to complete all the tasks on time to make sure you
complete the bootcamp in 7.5 months.
Below is an example what your calendar will look like on your dashboard.
HOW THIS BOOTCAMP WILL WORK
Daily tasks view when you 
zoom into each calendar tile

In our commitment to fostering a disciplined and results-driven
learning environment, your calendar serves as a visual representation
of your progress. Here's a breakdown of the color-coded system:
Green Tiles (Same Day Completion): Demonstrates your ability to
meet deadlines promptly, showcasing a strong work ethic and
commitment to timely task completion.
Yellow Tiles (Late Completion): Indicates completion after the
designated day or more. While not ideal, it serves as a valuable
learning opportunity to enhance time management skills.
Blue Tiles (Advance Completion - One Day or More): Reflects
proactive planning and efficiency, showcasing your ability to work
ahead of schedule.
Red Tiles (Incomplete): Highlights tasks that remain unfinished for
the day, signaling a need for attention and completion. Something
you need to avoid.

On discord we have a levelling system. This system allows us to gauge
who are most engaging individual in the community and gives us a
sense of your ability to help your peers and be a good team member.
This plays a huge part of your soft skills and we are able to confident say
‘Yes’ to companies who are looking to hire from us when they ask us
about your ability to work in a team. 
Here are the various tags you can attain :
Lvl 1 Code Explorer – Just starting out and exploring the basics.
Lvl 2 Curious Coder – Showing interest and asking thoughtful questions.
Lvl 4 Helper – Actively helping others by answering questions.
Lvl 6 Team Player – Demonstrating good teamwork and collaboration.
Lvl 9 Mentor in Training – Starting to mentor and guide others in
coding.
Lvl 12 Team Player Pro – Working well in teams and contributing to
group

be Curious Coder and the Code Explorer tag will fall away.

As you approach the end of our bootcamp handbook, we want to share
the exciting prospects that await you.
Zaio is committed to supporting students in securing placements
within our network of partner companies, offering opportunities for
Junior Developer roles or paid internships. Achieving a final mark of 70%
and above significantly enhances your chances of placement.
Paid internships go for 12 months, providing a monthly salary of R4000.
Junior Developer full-time roles offer competitive salaries ranging from
R10,000 to R15,000 per month.
The focus in your initial year should not solely be on the salary; it's about
establishing yourself in the tech industry. Exponential salary growth is
anticipated from the second year onwards.
Your primary objective should be accumulating experience at tech
companies, setting the stage for sustained career growth.
